method: Keep an existing supported in-photo varying-background palette crop unless an independent paper-outline audit fails. In that event, try robust colour medians, constrained three-colour foreground mixtures, no upper-diameter contrast reward and segmentation-only lower edges. Accept only a supported in-photo alternative that passes the same audit on unchanged original fields. The crop selector never receives artwork, known corners or template quality.
scope: Development diagnostics. Existing crop controls plus fourteen newly rendered known-valid frame photographs; not an independent held-out result, no model training or split changes. Only the two painted original failures activate the fallback in full-pipeline tests. They do not have known exact cutting witnesses.

paintedFailurePipeline.independentRenderer: resvg from exported cut_geometry.json; painted ideal separately drawn as SVG
paintedFailurePipeline.remaining: Corrected exports still have 4.23% and 6.30% disagreement with the painted source, including corner seams and protrusions. No claim of an exact template solution.

enclosureRendering.scope: No refitting and no geometry changes. Repeat the same source mask by nearest-neighbour integer scaling. Compare native point sampling with independent resvg area coverage at three resolutions and thresholds. The exact witness is evaluated too, to distinguish fitting errors from point-contact topology in the original design. Enclosure measurements are raster evidence, not exact geometry predicates.

enclosurePolygonCheck.scope: Same fixed cuts as the renderer probe. Independently flatten exported cubics and form even-odd colour regions with Clipper2. Check each protected source-region centre against polygon components and boundary contact. Three finite flattening tolerances and eight decimal places establish numerical stability here, not an exact algebraic topology certificate.

qualifications: Ten-second fit settings are not total wall-time guarantees; imports and final validation are additional.
Timing-dependent fitting changed one pair despite identical crops and masks; this is not an effect of crop recovery.

The two raw raster feature failures are retained. Separate polygon checks at 0.01, 0.001 and 0.0001 mm find all four small components enclosed; do not interpret a single binary-render connection as an established geometric opening.
All three known-witness runs and painted-frame run verified their source hash manifests after completion.
No production source changes, browser integration checks or physical assembly tests in this experiment.
nextAction: Integrate the conditional recovery using shared preparation and an explicit observed-outline audit, preserving all existing crop gates.
